nodes.title: 📋 SETUP & USAGE GUIDE
widgets_values:
# Mehak IA2V Lip-Sync Workflow
**Based on TensorAlchemist's LTX 2.3 IA2V workflow**

---

## 🔴 BEFORE FIRST RUN — Install these

**1. Update ComfyUI-LTXVideo** (Manager → search LTXVideo → Try Update)
Needed for nodes: `07d8e67d` and `3a916bdf`

**2. Download AV LoRA** (if not already):
`LTX-2.3-22b-AV-LoRA-talking-head-v1.safetensors`
→ HuggingFace: `elix3r/LTX-2.3-22b-AV-LoRA-talking-head`
→ Save to: `models/loras/`

---

## 🟡 CHANGES TO MAKE PER RUN

### 1. Select your image
→ `LoadImage` node — select your mehaklora portrait
→ Front-facing, face fills frame, simple background

### 2. Set audio clip
→ `TrimAudioDuration` → `start_index` widget:
- Clip 1: **0**
- Clip 2: **25**
- Clip 3: **50**
→ Duration stays at **25** (seconds)

### 3. Update the prompt
→ Replace `[your lyrics here]` with the actual words sung in that 25s section
→ Keep `mehaklora OHWXPERSON` at the start — both trigger words required

### 4. Update filename prefix
→ `VHS_VideoCombine` → change `Mehak_MusicVideo_Clip1` to `Clip2`, `Clip3` etc.

---

## 🟢 SETTINGS REFERENCE

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Resolution | 960 × 540 (landscape, matches LoRA training) |
| FPS | 24 |
| Clip duration | 25 seconds |
| AV LoRA strength | 0.88 (do not change) |
| mehaklora strength | **0.4** (start here, adjust up to 0.6 if face drifts) |
| Sampler | euler_ancestral_cfg_pp |
| CFG | 1.0 |
| Sigmas | Manual: 1.0→0.99→0.98→0.97→0.90→0.72→0.42→0.0 |

---

## 🔵 PROMPT FORMAT

```
mehaklora OHWXPERSON [description of scene and performance].
The person is singing, and she says: "[exact lyrics of this clip]"
```

**Example:**
```
mehaklora OHWXPERSON young woman vocalist singing into microphone,
studio background, warm lighting, expressive face.
The person is singing, and she says: "Waka waka eh eh, this time for Africa"
```

---

## ⚠️ EXPECTED GENERATION TIME (RTX 3060 12GB)
- 25 second clip: **~18-25 minutes**
- Uses SSD offloading — normal, expected
- VRAM peak: ~11-12GB

---

## 🟣 MODEL FILES REQUIRED

| File | Folder |
|---|---|
| `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-Q5_K_M.gguf` | models/unet/ or diffusion_models |
| `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_video_vae.safetensors` | models/vae/ |
| `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_audio_vae.safetensors` | models/vae/ |
| `gemma-3-12b-it-IQ4_XS.gguf` | models/text_encoders/ |
| `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_embeddings_connectors.safetensors` | models/text_encoders/ |
| `LTX-2.3-22b-AV-LoRA-talking-head-v1.safetensors` | models/loras/ |
| `mehaklora-ltx.safetensors` | models/loras/ |

nodes.title: AUDIO SWITCH GUIDE
widgets_values:
# 🎵 AUDIO ON / OFF SWITCH

Click the **AUDIO ON / OFF SWITCH** node to toggle:

**Audio ON (green):** Real audio file → IA2V lip sync → RTX upscale
- Set your MP3 in LoadAudio node
- Character lip syncs to the actual song

**Audio OFF (red):** No audio file needed → i2v with dialogue from prompt
- Edit the prompt in the Audio OFF positive CLIPTextEncode
- LTX generates audio from the prompt text
- Uses 2-pass latent upscaler (better quality, more VRAM)
- Output saved as Mehak_AudioOFF_xxxxx.mp4

# 🔀 Manual ↔ AI Prompt Toggle

## Currently: MANUAL MODE (default)
The "✏️ MANUAL PROMPT" Textbox feeds into Switch input1.
Switch always picks the FIRST active input.

---

## To switch to AI MODE (QwenVL auto-generates prompt):
1. Right-click "✏️ MANUAL PROMPT" → Bypass
2. Right-click nodes 601, 602, 604 → Un-bypass each
   (StringConcatenate → QwenVL → showAnything)
3. Make sure QwenVL has an image connected

## To switch back to MANUAL MODE:
1. Right-click "✏️ MANUAL PROMPT" → Un-bypass
2. QwenVL chain can stay active or be bypassed
   (Manual input1 always wins over AI input2)

---
Edit your prompt directly in the MANUAL PROMPT node above.
